title: Lubricant R&D material / coating / interface record
description: Interface object (WP-09): one material / coating / tribological contact pair and the compatibility evidence collected for it. A resource object like bench (WP-05), not a chain stage: it records who meets whom (counterpart a/b), the coating system when one side is coated, and per-condition compatibility observations. The fail-closed verdict rule mirrors application.schema.json: a PASS verdict is only admissible with non-empty, all-OBSERVED, all-PASS compatibility evidence and no GAP evidence; an empty evidence list forces verdict GAP. design_freeze's COMPATIBILITY_PASSED freeze condition must cite this artifact as INTERFACE:<interface_id> and the cited record must carry a PASS verdict (enforced by skills/interface-definition/scripts/interface_policy.freeze_compatibility_errors and the e2e contract; the schema-level pattern on design_freeze is deferred while tests/test_r25_contracts.py is owned by the parallel WP-12).

project_reference.description: Project this record is made for; also used as the artifact project_id by the builder.

coating.description: Optional coating-system parameters. External dependency (DLC coating parameters, supplier batches) is handled by declaration: either the whole object is present with its provenance, or it is omitted entirely — never partially guessed.

compatibility_evidence.description: Per-condition compatibility observations; may be empty, which forces verdict GAP.

designation.description: Trade name, grade, or coating system designation.

coating_reference.description: DLC coating-parameter sheet or equivalent external reference.

surface_hardness.description: Positive value; unit carried in the sibling hardness_unit.

method_reference.description: Qualified test method that produced the observation.

condition.description: Human-readable test condition (load, temperature, duration, media).
